text: I'm so sorry to bother you this late, I know you must be busy and it's probably nothing. My little boy is 4 and his temperature is 39.3. He was sick once earlier this evening but he's had a few drinks since and kept them all down, so I think that's ok? His eczema is flaring too, dry itchy patches on his tummy and wrists and he keeps scratching at them. I just didn't know if the temperature was too high or if I'm overreacting. Sorry again
